passages.text: For the choirmaster. A Psalm of David.
passages.sermon: David wrote this psalm.\r\nHe gave it to the choirmaster.\r\nThe choirmaster led music in worship.

passages.text: May the LORD answer you in the day of trouble; may the name of the God of Jacob protect you.
passages.sermon:
David wrote this psalm for the choirmaster.
The LORD is the God of Jacob.
The LORD can answer you when you are in trouble.
The name of the God of Jacob can protect you.
May the LORD answer you in the day of trouble.
May the name of the God of Jacob protect you.
passages.original: לַמְנַצֵּ֗חַ מִזְמ֥וֹר לְדָוִֽד׃ יַֽעַנְךָ֣ יְ֭הוָה בְּי֣וֹם צָרָ֑ה יְ֝שַׂגֶּבְךָ֗ שֵׁ֤ם׀ אֱלֹהֵ֬י יַעֲקֹֽב׃

passages.text: May He send you help from the sanctuary and sustain you from Zion.
passages.sermon:
This is a Psalm of David.
David speaks to God.
David asks God to send you help.
God’s help comes from His holy sanctuary.
David asks God to support you.
God’s support comes from Zion.

passages.text: May He remember all your gifts and look favorably on your burnt offerings. Selah May He give you the desires of your heart and make all your plans succeed.
passages.sermon:
God remembers your gifts.
God looks with favor on your burnt offerings.
God gives you the desires of your heart.
God makes all your plans succeed.
passages.original: יִזְכֹּ֥ר כָּל־ מִנְחֹתֶ֑ךָ וְעוֹלָתְךָ֖ יְדַשְּׁנֶ֣ה סֶֽלָה׃ יִֽתֶּן־ לְךָ֥ כִלְבָבֶ֑ךָ וְֽכָל־ עֲצָתְךָ֥ יְמַלֵּֽא׃

passages.text: May we shout for joy at your victory and raise a banner in the name of our God. May the LORD grant all your petitions.
passages.sermon: We will shout for joy because God gives you victory.\r\nWe will lift up a banner in the name of our God.\r\nThe LORD will give you everything you ask for.
passages.original: נְרַנְּנָ֤ה׀ בִּ֘ישׁ֤וּעָתֶ֗ךָ וּבְשֵֽׁם־ אֱלֹהֵ֥ינוּ נִדְגֹּ֑ל יְמַלֵּ֥א יְ֝הוָ֗ה כָּל־ מִשְׁאֲלוֹתֶֽיךָ׃

passages.text: Now I know that the LORD saves His anointed; He answers him from His holy heaven with the saving power of His right hand.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is God.
The LORD saves His anointed one.
I know this now.
The LORD answers His anointed from His holy heaven.
The LORD uses the power of His right hand to save.
passages.original: עַתָּ֤ה יָדַ֗עְתִּי כִּ֤י הוֹשִׁ֥יעַ׀ יְהוָ֗ה מְשִׁ֫יח֥וֹ יַ֭עֲנֵהוּ מִשְּׁמֵ֣י קָדְשׁ֑וֹ בִּ֝גְבֻר֗וֹת יֵ֣שַׁע יְמִינֽוֹ׃

passages.text: Some trust in chariots and others in horses, but we trust in the name of the LORD our God.
passages.sermon: Some people trust in chariots.\r\nOther people trust in horses.\r\nWe trust in the name of the LORD our God.
passages.original: אֵ֣לֶּה בָ֭רֶכֶב וְאֵ֣לֶּה בַסּוּסִ֑ים וַאֲנַ֓חְנוּ׀ בְּשֵׁם־ יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֣ינוּ נַזְכִּֽיר׃

passages.text: They collapse and fall, but we rise up and stand firm.
passages.sermon:
Some people collapse.
Some people fall.
We rise up.
We stand firm.
passages.original: הֵ֭מָּה כָּרְע֣וּ וְנָפָ֑לוּ וַאֲנַ֥חְנוּ קַּ֝֗מְנוּ וַנִּתְעוֹדָֽד׃

passages.text: O LORD, save the king. Answer us on the day we call.
passages.sermon:
The people pray to the LORD.
They ask the LORD to save their king.
They ask the LORD to answer them.
They want the LORD to respond when they call for help.
passages.original: יְהוָ֥ה הוֹשִׁ֑יעָה הַ֝מֶּ֗לֶךְ יַעֲנֵ֥נוּ בְיוֹם־ קָרְאֵֽנוּ׃
